What should I do if the tracking never updates?

If tracking hasn’t updated, give it a little time first since carriers can lag behind scans. If there’s still no movement after 10 business days from the last tracking update, send your order number or checkout email and I’ll check it for you. If the tracking link itself is broken, send that too.

Your tracking link is usually in the shipping confirmation email sent once the order goes out. Check your inbox, spam, and promotions folders for an email from Bellesa with your tracking details. If you can’t find it, send your order number or checkout email and I’ll check for you.
